summary: Critical outage in inventory-service caused by certificate_expiry (INC-0022)
description: Service inventory-service incident INC-0022. Symptoms: TLS handshake failures. Error: javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path validation failed: certificate expired. Root cause was certificate_expiry. Followed runbook RB-cert-expiry.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for inventory-service and applied RB-cert-expiry.
